newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Q4 current account surplus at US$2.757 bln.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Q4 current account surplus at US$2.757 bln.

text.p: Taiwan's current account balance was a US$2.757 billion surplus in the fourth quarter compared with a surplus of US$3.459 billion a year earlier, the central bank said on Thursday.

High international crude oil prices and the island's purchases of military equipment in the fourth quarter of 1996 were given by the central bank as reasons for the fall in the current account balance from the fourth quarter of 1995.
The current account balance for the entire 1996 was a $10.481 billion surplus, compared with $4.824 billion of surplus in 1995, the bank said.
